summary: Component L1 of ADR-0142, in the new package go/internal/retryladder. Classify a failed try as infra, quota, halt, spec, capability or unknown from host facts only (spec §3): exit codes, the usage-probe bench, the audit failure class, host-proven BLOCKER claims, floor failures inside or outside the lane scope. Fingerprint = the violation-code set of the first failed check (reuse the identity of core/contract_escalation.go), else normalized text. Spec docs/architecture/retry-ladder.md §3; ADR-0142.
title: Retry ladder L1: the deterministic failure classifier
